criteria.name: LLM Explanations & Prompt Engineering
criteria.guidance: Use explicit prompts to summarize validated purchase insights without inventing metrics or causal claims.

criteria.name: RAG: Ingestion/Retrieval/Grounding
criteria.guidance: Implement or clearly evidence document ingestion, chunking, retrieval, metadata/source citations and grounded answers.

criteria.name: Text-to-SQL & Query Safety
criteria.guidance: Translate natural language to validated read-only SQL; enforce schema limits and reject write/multi-statement queries.

criteria.name: AI Agent Orchestration
criteria.guidance: Demonstrate meaningful routing/tool use among analysis, retrieval and SQL components with traceable outputs.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Responsible AI
criteria.guidance: Test factuality, retrieval grounding, prompt injection, privacy and fairness; document failure cases and human review.
